improvements.rationale: A compelling meta description improves click-through rates from search results by clearly communicating the product value and free trial offer. Open Graph and Twitter Card tags ensure professional, branded previews when the homepage is shared on LinkedIn, Facebook, or Twitter—critical for B2B audiences. The copy highlights key differentiators (AI-powered, voice chat, trade focus) and the low-friction entry point (three free searches) without inventing claims.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Meet Gideon — Your AI-Powered Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Get instant answers, voice chat support, and a professional workspace built for business owners and traders. Try three free searches — no card required."
improvements.rationale: The headline immediately names the product and clarifies its purpose, building brand recognition. The subheading highlights three key value props (instant answers, voice chat, workspace) while addressing the target audience directly. Ending with the free trial offer and 'no card required' removes friction and encourages immediate engagement.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches with Gideon, you'll be prompted to choose a membership plan to continue. Plans start at just US$2 per day, billed monthly—or save 30% with annual billing. As a member, you unlock unlimited access to Gideon's workspace, voice chat, and full trade and business support.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point in the conversion funnel—what happens at the paywall. By clearly explaining the transition from free to paid, stating exact pricing, and reinforcing the value of membership, it reduces uncertainty and helps move prospects toward conversion.
